limits.responseBytes: decoded JavaScript response bodies with successful JavaScript Content-Type responses; repeated URL responses count
limits.artifactBytes: decoded emitted .js/.mjs/.cjs files and independent per-file gzipSync estimates
excluded: wire transfer bytes, Content-Length, Brotli, headers, HTML, inline scripts, RSC/Flight, CSS, images, and fonts
deduplicated transfer size, before/after comparisons, rankings, and cross-example totals
limits.nextCatalogBytes: null where Next catalog code cannot be attributed separately from hashed bundles
